description: The agent-native Fiken CLI: full read coverage with offline search and a local SQLite mirror, plus the gated, audited, idempotent write and bank-reconciliation layer no other Fiken tool has.

auth_env_var_specs.name: FIKEN_API_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Personal API token (Fiken -> Settings -> API -> Personlige API-nokler). Sent as a Bearer token; never expires; ToS-clean for your own companies. Set this OR run 'auth login' for OAuth2.

auth_env_var_specs.name: FIKEN_CLIENT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client ID, used only by 'auth login' when acting on behalf of other companies. Not needed if you use a personal API token.

auth_env_var_specs.name: FIKEN_CLIENT_SECRET
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client secret, used only by 'auth login'. Not needed if you use a personal API token.

novel_features.name: Unverified-against-bank detector
novel_features.description: Lists postings on your bank accounts that aren't yet matched to the bank statement, and shows the exact ledger-vs-reconciled gap per account.

novel_features.name: Client-side posting validation
novel_features.description: Dry-runs a proposed posting before it touches the books: balanced debit/credit in øre, account exists, MVA code plausible for the account, period open, date sane.

novel_features.name: Idempotent audited commit
novel_features.description: Posts a validated purchase or journal entry through a guarded path: deduped against the idempotency map, date-aligned to the expected bank-line date, X-Request-ID stamped, and recorded in an append-only audit log in the same call.

novel_features.name: Imbalance & rounding-drift finder
novel_features.description: Scans journal entries for debit≠credit imbalances and sub-krone øreavrunding drift using exact integer-øre arithmetic.

novel_features.name: VAT-code anomaly detector
novel_features.description: Flags sale/purchase lines whose VAT code is implausible for the account or deviates from how that vendor is usually posted.

novel_features.name: MVA / VAT-period summary
novel_features.description: Reconstructs a VAT-return-shaped view from local lines: net basis and output/input VAT bucketed per VAT code, for any period.

novel_features.name: Period BI rollup
novel_features.description: Grouped revenue/cost/margin rollups over the local mirror by month, account, project, or contact.

novel_features.name: Posting proposal builder
novel_features.description: Turns an inbox document into a structured posting proposal: pulls the bilag, the vendor's posting history, candidate accounts, and the valid MVA codes in one call.

novel_features.name: Audited reversal
novel_features.description: Reverses a posting with a correcting entry or soft-delete, recording the link back to the original in the audit log.

novel_features.name: Duplicate-posting suspicion
novel_features.description: Surfaces suspected double-postings: the same contact and øre amount within a date window across purchases and sales.

novel_features.name: Payment reconciliation
novel_features.description: Registers and settles payments on sales and purchases, including clearing-account journal entries for payment processors.

novel_features.name: Audit event sink
novel_features.description: Appends a grammar-validated event to the append-only audit log; warns on an unknown operation name but never rejects.

novel_features.name: Missing-bilag report
novel_features.description: Lists postings in a period that have no attached documentation (empty attachments).

novel_features.name: Vendor posting-history profile
novel_features.description: Shows how a vendor is usually posted: the modal account and VAT code, with frequency and last-used.
